subject.callable: direct Triton float32 probability-target KL batchmean loss and input VJP
subject.boundary: one launch reads complete contiguous 8x64 input and target matrices and writes one scalar loss plus every coordinate of the 8x64 input VJP

tasks.task_statement: Compute the selected PyTorch 2.10 probability-target float32 KL batchmean scalar and the complete input VJP for scalar upstream 1 from two received contiguous 8x64 matrices.

input_map.basis: the wrapper accepts only float32 input
the wrapper accepts only float32 target
the kernel divides the complete pointwise sum by the fixed batch size
the kernel applies log to the received probability-space target
the returned VJP is for scalar upstream one
